_doc: #873 FLEET SETUP policy, read by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-fleet-setup-guard.py (fleet-setup-guard.yml, every push). Every app that fleet-config.json declares migrating (config/secret) stores for must link the setup provider (`<package>.fleetsetup`, libs:fleetconfig-model SetupProvider, merged in through libs:core) and every such store must have a handler: prefs / encrypted are served by the default; any other kind registers one (SetupStores.register) or is listed under `unserved` with the reason. The declarations themselves live in the manifest; this file only holds what the guard cannot derive: the exemptions and the stores awaiting a handler.
_doc_exempt: {<app module dir>: <reason>}. Empty today: every fleet app links libs:core (forks, the IME and the single-WebView apps included), so each one answers. An app that cannot link it (no Gradle project, a build that cannot take a project dependency) goes here WITH the reason; an exemption for an app that links is stale and fails.

ac_cloud-mail.datastore:settings: a Preferences DataStore the app holds a live in-memory copy of: a handler has to write through the app's own DataStore instance, so it is registered by the app (SetupStores.register in App.kt) - not yet; describe reports served:false and Fleet Setup names it.
